exposure: community birth care for twin pregnancies
cohort: The study included 100 consecutive twin pregnancies planning community births with a single community practitioner over a 12-year period.
finding: Community birth can lead to high rates of vaginal birth and good outcomes for both mothers and babies in properly selected twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: The vaginal birth rate for twin pregnancies under community care was 91.3%, with multiparas having higher rates of vaginal birth and less perineal trauma compared to primiparas.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, but specific values for the cohort are not reported in the abstract.
